# Install and load nycflights13 for flight data
if (!requireNamespace("nycflights13", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("nycflights13")
}
library(nycflights13)

if (!requireNamespace("tibble", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("tibble")
}
library(tibble)
class(flights)

[1] "tbl_df"     "tbl"        "data.frame"

flights <- as_tibble(flights)
head(flights)

Q2

flight1 <- flights |> filter(month == 1)

dist_tbl <- flight1 |>
  group_by(carrier) |>
  summarise(
    mean_distance = mean(distance),
    sd_distance = sd(distance)
  )
dist_tbl <- dist_tbl |> arrange(mean_distance)
dist_tbl

Q3
NA will be shown when there is only one observation in the data set, hence the SD is not valid (divisible by 0 error), such as the case with carrier OO
However, the standard deviation can be 0, as is seen by carrier YV which is observed 46 times in the data set.

Flights2 <- flight1 |>
  filter(carrier == "OO" | carrier=="YV") |>
  count(carrier)


Flights2

  <chr>   <int>
1 OO          1
2 YV         46


Q4

flights3 <-  flights|> 
  group_by(carrier, month) |> 
  summarize(
    avg_delay = mean(dep_delay, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

`.groups` argument.

Q5

flightsDelay <- flights |>
  mutate(Q6 = ifelse((dep_delay>0 & arr_delay<=0),1,0)
    )|>
  summarize(
    proportion = mean(Q6, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
flightsDelay

# A tibble: 1 × 1
  proportion
       <dbl>
1      0.108


Q6

airlines <- as_tibble(airlines)
flights4 <- flights |>
  mutate(
    flightPath = str_c(origin, dest, sep = "-")
    )|> 
      group_by(flightPath) |> 
        mutate(carrier_count = n_distinct(carrier)) |> 
          ungroup() |> 
            filter(carrier_count > 1)|>
              left_join(airlines |> select(carrier, name), by = "carrier")

library(ggplot2)
#Initialisation of vectors
set.seed(1)
n <- 100
X <- 1:n
e <- rnorm(n, mean = 0, sd = 0.2)
Y <- sin(X/10) + e
smth <- numeric(n)


#Lowess function creation
customLowess <- function(x,y,f){
  k <- ceiling(n*f)
  for(i in X){
    X_i = X[i]
    distances <- abs(X - X_i)
    knn_indices <- order(distances)[0:k+1]
    knn_distances <- distances[knn_indices]
    knn_values <- X[knn_indices]
    dmax = knn_distances[k+1]
    XM = cbind(1,knn_values)
    W <- matrix(0, nrow = k + 1, ncol = k + 1)
    YM = rep(1,k+1)
    for(j in 0:k+1){
      W[j,j]=(1-(knn_distances[j]/dmax)^3)^3
    }
    for(p in 1:k+1){
      a = knn_values[p]
      YM[p] = Y[a]
    }
  B <- solve(t(XM)%*%W%*%XM)%*%t(XM)%*%W%*%YM
  y_hat = B[1] + B[2]*X_i
  smth[i]=y_hat
  }
  return(smth)
}

ans = customLowess(X,Y,f=0.3)
L <- lowess(X,Y,f=0.3,iter=0)
plot(X, Y, type = "o", col = "black", main = "Plot of smoothing function comparison",ylab = "Y", xlab = "X")
lines(X,ans,col="blue",lwd=2)
lines(L, col="red",lwd=2)
